verdict.rationale: Signing in with a personal account for free-tier access is a fair question for a SaaS coding agent like Devin, so the axis applies. The pack documents only paid self-serve plans (Pro, and Max for users who exceed the Pro quota). It shows no free tier and no personal-account sign-in flow that avoids API keys. A community mention of trialing Devin does not establish a documented free tier.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys
